_why: The exiftool shipped in the SpeciesViewer download. The official Windows 64-bit package from exiftool.org; tools/svr_build_zip.py refuses any file whose SHA-256 differs. To upgrade: download the new package, test it, update all three fields.
tested: 2026-10-11, read / write (persistent and one-off) / preview extraction on OM-1 Mark II ORF
